name: sourcehut pages
line: Publish static sites from sourcehut repositories with automatic TLS.

free.text: Alpha payment optional; site limit 1 GiB; no permanent free promise

cells.selfhost: Yes; AGPLv3, self-host guide is work in progress

work.math: $4 a month or €4 account fee before tax. Bandwidth, request and build allowances are not quantified, so the full static-site total is unknown.
Pages does not provide an application runtime for APIs.
Requires external application hosting and PostgreSQL/backup services.
